brand.name: Brass & Blade
brand.tagline: Classic cuts, sharp fades and hot towel shaves in the heart of Surry Hills. Walk in, or book your chair.
brand.description: Brass & Blade is a fictional barbershop used as a concept demo: classic cuts, skin fades, hot towel shaves, memberships and a spinning 3D barber pole.
brand.demoFooter: Concept demo by KB Ventures. Not a real business.

forms.note: Paste your Formspree (or similar) address between the quote marks to make the booking, careers, newsletter and gift-card forms send real emails. Leave empty to keep the demo behaviour.

staff.name: Marco
staff.blurb: Seventeen years behind the chair. Skin fades, classic cuts and the best neckline in the building.

staff.name: Jess
staff.blurb: Scissor cuts, long hair and kids. Calm, quick and good at making nervous clients laugh.

staff.name: Dev
staff.blurb: Straight-razor shaves and beard sculpting. Will tell you exactly why your beard is itchy.

staff.name: Ollie
staff.blurb: Second-year apprentice with a steady hand. Lower prices on weekday afternoons while he learns.

services.label: Haircuts
services.note: Every cut includes a consultation and a hot towel finish

items.name: Classic Cut
items.desc: Scissors and clippers, tailored to your head shape. Finished with a hot towel and styling.

items.name: Skin Fade
items.desc: A seamless zero-to-skin blend, a sharp neckline and a straight-razor edge-up.

items.name: Scissor Cut
items.desc: Cut entirely with shears for longer styles, with a wash and style to finish.

items.name: Kids’ Cut (under 12)
items.desc: Patient, friendly and quick. Booster seat and a lolly for good behaviour.

items.name: Senior Cut (65+)
items.desc: A classic short back and sides at a kinder price. Weekdays before 2pm.

items.name: Buzz Cut
items.desc: One guard, even all over, with a crisp neckline.

items.name: Hot Towel Shave
items.desc: The full ritual: hot towels, rich lather, a straight razor and a cooling balm.

items.name: Beard Trim & Shape
items.desc: Tidy the length, define the lines and soften the edges.

items.name: Beard Sculpt
items.desc: A full reshape with razor lines, a trim, oil and a hot towel.

items.name: Head Shave
items.desc: Hot towel, lather and a razor-smooth finish from crown to neck.

items.name: Moustache Tidy
items.desc: A quick trim and shape, with a little wax if you like.

items.name: Neck & Edge Clean-Up
items.desc: Razor the neckline and sharpen the edges between cuts.

services.label: Packages
services.note: Save up to $25 compared with booking separately

items.name: The Full Works
items.desc: A cut, a hot towel shave, a scalp massage and styling. The whole experience.

items.name: Cut & Beard
items.desc: Any cut with a beard trim and shape, finished with hot towels.

items.name: Father & Son
items.desc: Two chairs side by side: a cut for you and one for your kid (under 12).

items.name: The Groom’s Package
items.desc: Cut, shave and scalp treatment, booked ahead for the big day, with a drink on the house.

items.name: Fade & Beard Trim
items.desc: A skin fade and a beard trim in one sitting.

items.name: The Quick Tidy
items.desc: A cut and neck clean-up for when you are short on time.

items.name: Scalp Massage
items.desc: Five minutes of firm, slow hands and warming oil.

items.name: Grey Blending
items.desc: Subtle colour that softens grey without a harsh line.

items.name: Eyebrow Tidy
items.desc: A quick shape and trim, no thread or wax needed.

items.name: Ear & Nose Wax
items.desc: Quick, clean and over faster than you expect.

items.name: Charcoal Face Mask
items.desc: A deep-clean mask with a hot towel to finish.

items.name: Hair Wash & Style
items.desc: A wash, a condition and the product of your choice.

products.name: Matte Clay Pomade, 100g
products.desc: Strong hold with a natural matte finish. Our most-used product in the chair.

products.name: Cedar & Orange Beard Oil, 30ml
products.desc: Softens, conditions and smells like a very good workshop.

products.name: Sandalwood Shave Soap
products.desc: A dense, creamy lather that lasts for months. Use with a brush.

products.name: Brass-Tipped Beard Comb
products.desc: Hand-finished, anti-static and small enough for a back pocket.

products.name: Safety Razor Starter Set
products.desc: A weighty brass razor, ten blades and a travel case. Easy to learn.

products.name: Cooling Aftershave Balm, 100ml
products.desc: Calms razor burn and leaves skin soft, not greasy.

memberships.name: The Regular
memberships.headline: Two cuts a month
memberships.text: Any haircut, twice a month, with a hot towel finish. Priority booking and 10% off the shop.

memberships.name: The Gentleman
memberships.headline: Two cuts and a shave
memberships.text: Two haircuts and a hot towel shave every month, priority booking, 15% off the shop and a free beard oil on joining.

memberships.name: Unlimited
memberships.headline: As often as you like
memberships.text: Unlimited haircuts and beard trims, one hot towel shave a month and 20% off the shop. Fair use, one visit a week.
